description:
As we gain new perspectives through our daily experiences, we continue to change little by little. Small realizations and choices accumulate along the way, eventually leading to greater change. Beyond that threshold lies a landscape different from what we knew before. The title Threshold represents the feeling that arises at the moment we cross that boundary—not a dramatic transformation, but a subtle yet undeniable sense that something has changed. The piece reflects the hesitation before taking that first step and the new landscape that begins to unfold beyond it.
